title: XL-LEXEME: WiC Pretrained Model for Cross-Lingual LEXical sEMantic changE

selection.evidence: The model every LSC paper read today uses as the standard (periti2024 NAACL, saponara2026, cassotti2025); arena-lsc's first system is built on it.

cost.compute_notes: PDF (9 pp) read in full. Model weights (HF pierluigic/xl-lexeme, 2.2 GB) and library (github pierluigic/xl-lexeme @0f6748d) run on an RX 6700 XT under ROCm: fp16 vs fp32, model-card known answer, ~135k usages embedded for arena-lsc.

triggers: bi-encoder word in context target word markers
best model for lexical semantic change SemEval-2020 Task 1

claims.statement: XL-LEXEME (XLM-R large Siamese bi-encoder, target marked with <t> </t>, contrastive loss margin 0.5 on cosine distance; trained on MCL-WiC, AM2iCo, XL-WiC train + 75% of their dev) ranks graded change (APD over usage pairs, 200 sampled sentences per period, 10 samples) at Spearman EN .757, DE .877, SV .754, LA -.056 on SemEval-2020 Task 1, and .809 avg on RuShiftEval (.825 fine-tuned on RuSemShift).
claims.scope: Two-period graded change; significance by Fisher z against each competitor; Latin fails (not in the WiC data).

our_assessment.why: Strong and replicated by others (periti2024 NAACL .751 weighted average with APD). Two caveats: with 31-48 target words the Fisher-z tests separate XL-LEXEME from most leaderboard systems but not from the cross-encoder or TempoBERT-class systems; and the paper says the sentence vector is the SUM of subword vectors while the released model's pooling config is MEAN - identical under cosine, so harmless, but a reader computing norms or dot products would see different numbers.

claims.statement: The released model runs in fp16 on a consumer AMD GPU (ROCm preview, Windows) with per-usage cosine to fp32 >= 0.99982 (1,983 Swedish usages), 163 usages/s, 1.17 GB peak; the model card's 'plane' example separates aircraft (cos .934) from geometric (.948) senses with cross-sense cos .07-.19. Raw (unnormalised) vectors have nearly constant norm (30.6 +- 0.29 on 86k English sentences).
claims.scope: arena-lsc Environment ticket and saponara2026 reanalysis r03.

our_assessment.why: Reader's own measurement; commands in the arena ticket outcome.

checked.result: loads with the vendored WordTransformer; fp16 safe; known answer passes

checked.how: vendored unmodified (sha256 in arena-lsc tooling/vendor/xl_lexeme/PROVENANCE.md) and imported

open_questions: How much of XL-LEXEME's SV performance survives on OCR-noisy 1880s Swedish (SemEval-2027 Task 3 SV older periods)? Per-period error analysis on SV dev is possible.
